description: Detect and exploit SQL injection (error-based, UNION, boolean/time blind, stacked). Load when a param feeds a query, you see DB errors, numeric/string params change result sets, login forms, search, sort/order-by, or ORM raw queries. Signals: "id=", 500 on a quote, "You have an error in your SQL syntax", MySQL/Postgres/MSSQL/Oracle banners.
